Alright, so let me tell you about these guys. This group's been together for about three years. I had had a Saturday afternoon group going for about a year before this group assembled; it was started as a Thursday evening group by one of my Saturday players. We played a bit of 2E, then some 1E Oriental Adventures, before settling into a d6 Star Wars game. A year ago, the guy running this group had a major job change, and it was going to keep him from running the Thursday folks. I stepped up to DM a 5E game, since I was about to make the hop from Labyrinth Lord to 5E with my Saturday folks. I figured running two games would make me learn the new rules faster.

Since then, the Thursday group has quickly become my "favorite" of the two groups I was running. They learned the rules well, they learned their characters even better, they showed up like clockwork and played the hell out of the game when we were together. It was a nice change of pace, as the Saturday folks had been petering out often lately. In fact, partly because of some scheduling changes at my job and partly because I had become burnt out with that group, tomorrow is my last session with the Saturday group; the GM seat will be filled by one of the guys in that group and they're moving on to a Savage Worlds campaign.

They are without question the best group I've ever played with. They RP well. They are insane at great tactical combat. They are never "that guy" in any way, whether it be "breaking" the game by doing stupid shit with their characters, or breaking the game by being assholes in person. They have helped by build and create a living world in a way that no group I've ever played with has (and I've been playing since '91). I'm a damn lucky DM.

What can I say. The group that I've been part of every Wednesday for the past 15 years is the best I've ever had. We've ranged from 5 to 7 members over the years.   • Star Wars in three different systems
  • Rune Quest

  • Champions

  • Stargate
  • Call of Cthulhu also in three different systems
  • Swashbukclers of the 7 Skies
  • Flashing Blades
  • A home brewed Fantasy system
  • A few others I can't remember.

They are some of the best people I know.
